problem: g518 retained 1468.149ms waiting for the local service ACK while its matching native apply measured 151.812ms. The six inner native-child spans and three parent spans do not cover the outer journal response boundary.
observation: ackRead.serviceIPC records the outer same-host exchange only after matching sequence/op. Six disjoint durations use the existing native IPC shape: phase 0 is zero, then request submission to journal read, read to handler admission, handler to reply-ready, reply-ready to app first positive Read return, then remaining decode. No raw timestamp is exported.
wire: Existing profiled local ACK suffix expands 44 -> 68 bytes, reserving 24 bytes for three outer QPC stamps beside the normalized inner profile. Both matching installed images are updated together. No new input, request, round trip or read/write operation. Peer network protocol is unchanged.
coexistence: Outer stamps do not replace native-child apply/submission or parent timing. Absent/invalid optional metadata is not an input result. Failed/truncated/foreign ACKs cannot publish a confirmed outer service profile.
limits: Reply-ready is immediately before the service Write call, not kernel arrival or Write completion. Phase 4 contains sender submission, pipe delivery and app scheduling; it cannot attribute them individually. Outer spans include input work and overlap inner native timing; never add them. The request-to-read span includes the app's Write, so the whole service profile is not bounded by ClientResponse alone.
budget: The existing tracked-input probe/window budget applies. QPC order and total <=120s are validated; unavailable clocks drop timing. Deep-copy ownership prevents caller mutation after collection. Input order, authority, outcomes and deadlines are unchanged.
validation: Five related package suites and go vet passed. Tests cover outer/inner coexistence, absent inner detail, reserved bytes, following-ACK framing, production serve population, matching-ACK/presence/window validation and snapshot ownership. A real-QPC transport test separates 12ms service processing from 18ms app read resumption without extra input.
delivery: Physical results and paired installation are recorded separately. No current root-cause resolution or measured physical improvement is claimed. No external API, DB, runner or repository hygiene change.
